display.purpose: Headword and status titles on a plate. Geist 400; 30px/34px in the notebook detail plate.

title.purpose: A window's own name, e.g. 'Notebook' at the head of the rail.

definition.purpose: English definition in an entry (14.5px/22px in the notebook detail).

body.purpose: General text, navigation items, word rows; examples at 13.5-14px in secondary ink.

control.purpose: Button, segment, field and context-menu text.

chinese.purpose: Translation under each definition; examples' Chinese at 13-13.5px in muted ink. WPF base style is 15px/23px.

ipa.purpose: Pronunciation only; Geist has no IPA glyphs.

label.purpose: Mono caps for field labels, column heads, part of speech, sense numbers, zero-padded counts, tokens, quiet text actions. Tracking applies on the web only (WPF has no letter-spacing). Never an eyebrow over a heading.

motion.name: seal-stamp
motion.purpose: The seal's one-time stamp when a word is first saved: scale 1.35 and -16deg to scale 1 and -8deg, opacity 0 to 1. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. No other motion in the system.

themes.mechanism: Themes/Light.xaml and Themes/Dark.xaml share one key list; ThemeService sets Fluent ThemeMode, then re-adds the palette and Shared.xaml after Fluent's dictionaries so they win. reader.css mirrors the palette as custom properties and switches on prefers-color-scheme. Night tokens carry the 'night-' prefix.
themes.fluentOverrides: ControlCornerRadius, OverlayCornerRadius, PopupCornerRadius = 0; AccentFillColor* and AccentTextFillColorPrimary = ink; ListViewItemPillFill = ink; AccentFillColorSelectedTextBackground = selection; TextControl* and ComboBox* borders = field-border, ink-secondary on hover, ink on focus; backgrounds transparent. ContextMenu style lives in each palette with a literal TextFillColorDisabledBrush override (ink-secondary).

focus.value: 1px solid ink rectangle, 3px outside the control
focus.purpose: FocusVisualStyle on every interactive control; web equivalent outline:1px solid var(--ink); outline-offset:3px.

fonts.Geist: bundled, SIL OFL (Assets/Fonts, licence included), 400 and 500

narrative.overview:
Every LookUp window is a plate from a design annual. The stock is an uncoated near-white that drifts warm at the top left to faintly cool at the bottom right; there is one ink, never pure black; one grotesque carries all English, and its mono sets the labels, counts and tokens. Structure comes from 1px hairline rules, not boxes or fills. Registration crosshairs sit at a plate's top corners, the way they would on a printed proof. The dictionary entry is the plate; the notebook reads like the annual's index of plates.

Colour is withheld so it can mean something. The single periwinkle accent exists for the notebook seal (a stamped disc with its text running round the ring and a two-digit count in the middle) and for the phrase a search matched. Everything else, including selection, hover and the primary action, is done in ink and neutral grounds. Controls are square, flat and printed: filled ink for the one primary action, 1px ink outline for secondary actions, mono caps on a hairline rule for quiet text actions.

The system rides on WPF's Fluent ThemeMode and overrides it rather than replacing it: corner radii are zeroed, Fluent's accent keys are re-pointed at ink, and field borders take the palette. Light and dark are the same plate; dark is the plate at night, near-black stock with the ink reversed and the seal deepened.
keyCharacteristics: Gradient stock (warm to cool, top left to bottom right), solid ground for menus and inset panels.
One ink at three strengths (ink, secondary, muted); no pure black, no pure white.
1px hairlines for structure; a 1px ink rule where something is emphasised (column heads, selected row, single-line field baseline, second part-of-speech section).
Square corners on every control, container and window.
Geist for English, Geist Mono 11px caps for labels and data, Microsoft JhengHei UI for Chinese, Segoe UI for IPA only.
One accent, periwinkle, for the seal and the matched phrase and nothing else.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: Periwinkle appears in exactly two places: the notebook seal and the phrase block a search matched. Selection, hover, focus, the current item and the primary action never use it. If a new surface wants colour, it does not get it.

rules.name: The Neutral Selection Rule
rules.body: A selected row is `press-fill` with its bottom rule turned to ink; text selection is `selection`. Selection reads as the plate being pressed, not tinted.

rules.name: The Ink Not Black Rule
rules.body: Text and fills use `ink` (and its night counterpart), never #000 or #FFF.

rules.name: The Regular Weight Rule
rules.body: Headwords and titles are Geist 400. Weight 500 is reserved for a phrase title or a bolded word inside an example; nothing in the UI is bold.

rules.name: The Label Is Not An Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Mono caps name a field, a column, a count or a token. They never sit above a heading as a decorative kicker.

rules.name: The Right Face For The Script Rule
rules.body: English in Geist, Chinese in JhengHei, IPA in Segoe UI. Never let IPA fall back inside Geist.

rules.name: The Printed Plate Rule
rules.body: Separation is a rule, not a shadow or a card. If two regions need dividing, draw a 1px hairline between them; if one needs emphasis, turn that rule to ink.

dos: **Do** keep every control, field, menu and window square (0px radius); keep circles for the seal, the navigation dot and the crosshair ring.
**Do** divide regions with a 1px `hairline` and emphasise with a 1px `ink` rule.
**Do** mark the current navigation item with the 5px ink dot and ink text.
**Do** show selection as `press-fill` with an ink rule, and text selection as `selection`.
**Do** set labels, counts and tokens in Geist Mono 11px caps, counts zero-padded (`03`).
**Do** give each view one filled-ink primary action; use the 1px ink outline for real secondary actions and mono text-on-a-rule for quiet ones.
**Do** keep light and dark palettes on one key list and add any new key to Light.xaml, Dark.xaml and reader.css together.
**Do** keep the "Open in Cambridge" action and Cambridge's source line visible on entries.
donts: **Don't** use periwinkle for anything except the seal and the matched phrase: not selection, hover, focus, links or the current item.
**Don't** fill a navigation item with ink to show it is current; filled ink means a primary action or the chosen segment.
**Don't** add drop shadows, cards or tinted panels to separate content.
**Don't** set headwords or titles bold; display type is Geist 400.
**Don't** put a mono caps label above a heading as an eyebrow.
**Don't** animate the seal continuously or on every lookup; it stamps once, in 180ms, and honours reduced motion.
**Don't** use pure black or pure white for ink or ground.
**Don't** put a shared brush in a style's `Style.Resources` when it must change with the theme; give each palette its own literal.
